name: devagent
description: Seven development skills for isolated changes, code structure, testing evidence, PR review, and clear writing.

interface.longDescription: Use seven focused skills for Git worktree isolation, reusable code structure, testing evidence, before/after comparisons, Greptile review loops, and editing prose. The plugin provides instructions and helper scripts, not connected services. Git, review tools, browsers, Python, and FFmpeg remain task-specific prerequisites. Installing the plugin does not install those tools or grant access to GitHub or other services.
defaultPrompt: Review this project's code structure without changing files.
Capture before and after evidence for this authorized change.
